title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.

title: EU's Kallas says Russia strike aimed to 'scare' Western backers
description: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said a drone attack near a train carrying European officials in Ukraine was designed to intimidate Western countries and undermine support for Kyiv, urging leaders to demonstrate increased solidarity rather than retreat from their commitments.

title: Türkiye ranks among top non-EU destinations for EU travelers
description: Eurostat data reveals that Türkiye ranked alongside the UK and Switzerland as one of the three most popular non-EU destinations for European travelers in 2024, while EU residents made 1.2 billion trips totaling €618 billion in expenditure during the period.

title: Iran police chief says 6,000 arrested over January protests
description: Iranian police chief Ahmadreza Radan said on Monday that authorities have arrested 6,000 people over their alleged role in anti-government protests that rocked the country in early January, vowing that detainees accused of staging a coup would not be released without expressions of regret and repentance.

title: US think tank spied on Muslims for 20 years
description: A report by Huffington Post has revealed that the Middle East Forum, a right-wing US think tank founded in 1994, compiled a database of more than 4 million records on thousands of Muslim Americans and Muslim institutions over nearly 20 years. The archive included identity details, social media accounts, tax records and information on mosques, schools and businesses.

title: Autumn migration brings rich bird diversity to Bursa's Kocacay Delta
description: As the autumn migration season gets underway, the Kocacay Delta in Bursa, Türkiye, is seeing a marked rise in biodiversity. The wetland, one of the country's key ecosystems, serves as a vital stopover for numerous migratory bird species, offering abundant food sources and shelter. Little stints were observed at the delta on July 16, 2026.

title: Finland joins French initiative on European nuclear deterrence
description: Finland's Defense Ministry announced on Monday that Helsinki will join France's nuclear deterrence initiative, stating that the bilateral framework aims to reinforce security across Europe while operating alongside — not replacing — NATO's existing deterrent capabilities based on Washington's extended guarantee.

title: Türkiye's civil aviation fleet reaches 1,772 craft at mid-year
description: The Transport and Infrastructure Ministry's Civil Aviation General Directorate reported that Türkiye's civil aviation fleet expanded to 1,772 registered craft by the end of June, with commercial carriers driving growth to meet demand at major hubs.

title: Austria denies visa to Iran nuclear chief for IAEA conference
description: Iran's Foreign Ministry confirmed on Monday that Austria denied a visa to atomic chief Mohammad Eslami, preventing his attendance at an IAEA conference in Vienna, and summoned Austria's charge d'affaires to protest the "absolutely unjustified" restriction.

title: Hormuz Strait talks set to reshape Gulf trade routes
description: Iran and Gulf countries will meet in Salalah, Oman, to discuss a lasting arrangement for commercial traffic through the Hormuz Strait. Tehran and Muscat say they have reached a preliminary understanding on securing shipping routes and are expected to present the deal at the meeting, while the United States is closely watching the outcome as its war with Iran continues.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base
description: Yemen's Houthis said they launched a large-scale missile and drone strike on King Khalid Air Base in southern Saudi Arabia, claiming significant damage to hangars and radars while vowing to continue operations in response to more than 300 Saudi airstrikes over the past five days.

title: IRGC destroys MQ-1 drone over Strait of Hormuz
description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Monday that its aerospace forces used a new advanced air defense system to intercept and destroy an MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, though the statement provided no information regarding the identity of the aircraft's operator or its mission.

title: Oil prices surge ahead of Fed decision, fueling inflation fears
description: Brent and West Texas Intermediate crude futures climbed more than 2% on Monday as markets brace for the Federal Reserve's policy rate decision this week, with Chairman Kevin Warsh warning that inflation remains too high and additional monetary tightening may be needed to bring price pressures back to target levels.

title: China urges restraint amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
description: China's Foreign Ministry on Monday expressed deep concern over civilian casualties and damage to Saudi energy infrastructure, urging all parties to exercise restraint and pursue dialogue as Houthi attacks threaten to disrupt the relative lull in Yemen's long-running war.

title: Iran says Saudi Arabia blocked Oman meeting on Hormuz
description: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baqaei said on Monday that Saudi Arabia requested the postponement of a planned Gulf foreign ministers' meeting in Oman that was expected to address maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz and present a tentative agreement between Tehran and Muscat.

title: US diesel prices reach record $6.23 per gallon on Monday
description: The American Automobile Association reported on Monday that US diesel prices reached $6.23 per gallon, marking the first time the fuel has exceeded the $6 threshold as global crude benchmarks trade at elevated levels, with President Donald Trump linking the surge to efforts blocking Iran's nuclear ambitions.

title: Yemen displacement tops 82,000 as Red Sea clashes intensify
description: The International Organization for Migration said more than 82,000 people have been displaced by intensifying clashes along Yemen's western coast since early September, with over 2,000 civilians reaching Djibouti by sea and local authorities in Aden racing to establish new displacement camps to accommodate the influx.

title: Trump says he asked Zelenskyy to halt Russian refinery strikes
description: US President Donald Trump said Sunday he asked Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to stop attacking Russian diesel refineries, warning that strikes on energy infrastructure were disrupting global supplies and pushing fuel prices higher.

title: AI could make thinking cheap. What happens to jobs, education and human purpose?
description: Dr. Pratosh, an IISc faculty member, warns that AI is not just coming for jobs—it could force a rethink of education, economics and what humans do for a living.
